BRIEFING.edit: Reduce direct/ambient contribution on the upper plaster and teal wainscot by roughly 20-30 luminance points while preserving the current ceiling warmth; add a localized warm floor pool instead of lifting the whole room.

Increase visible worn-but-maintained variation on the teal paint, timber floor, and bench boards; the target's chipped lower wall and orange-brown floor read more strongly than the current smooth dark surfaces.

Open the framing slightly at the bottom/right so both benches retain their target breathing room, and keep the left discipline poster and right doorway edge legible without changing the two-bench arrangement.

HALL.edit: Lower the end-wall, lower-teal, and tile values while increasing their red-minus-blue warmth (measured gaps: end wall +16 L/-20 W, lower wall +15 L/-10 W, floor +16 L/-15 W); keep the ceiling from receiving a global brightening.

Raise and slightly re-center the right-side anchor group: the briefing sign/door top and portrait sit about 50-100 px lower than the target in the 1600x900 render, while the cart is more cropped at the bottom. Preserve the open doorway and clear passage.
Add the target's stronger worn edges and legible layered paper detail to the shift board and corridor props; keep the extinguisher fully visible and leave only the right-edge pipe partial.

LOCKER.edit: Recover the ceiling by about 18 luminance points with a neutral/warm overhead contribution, while cutting the back-wall fill by about 50 points; use local shaping so the locker recesses remain readable without whitening the plaster.

Reduce the pod's apparent width by about 8-10% and shift the standing point/framing so the right locker bank, laundry/peg station, and trolley remain visible around it; keep the physical four identical lockers in two banks and the entrance clear.

Bring the locker-room palette back toward the target's muted teal lower wall and varied small tile pattern; retain the authorized jackets/towels but improve readable folds, shelf contents, and metal edge highlights instead of adding display suits.

limitations: This is an image-only comparison of the three pass-12 corner renders; Blender scene verification and route/contact checks are separate.

The AI targets use different camera projections, so anchor errors are treated as composition guidance only when they affect the target's visual intent; they are not a demand to reproduce impossible projective geometry.
DETAIL_FourLockers.png was used only to confirm the physical four-body/two-bank arrangement and was not substituted for the corner-vs-target score.

Scoring preserves the user's constraints: two briefing benches, four identical lockers, clear entrances, clear pod, matte timber, small tiles, used-maintained materials, and no displayed mannequin/coverall suits. Ordinary jackets and towels remain valid belongings.
